amendment.reason: The original prespecified 24 fine-grid cases all resolve at the nominal-power lower bound. Preserve those cases and append a deliberately higher-energy service challenge; do not claim energy-controlled fine-grid validation from the original subset.
amendment.source_selection: Same first newly seeded base geometry, all three particle arrangements, Solar Salt and FLiNaK; no selection on prediction success or outcome margin.
amendment.refined_inverse_count_source: results_v18/decision_grid_refinement_v16.csv: matching design_id/scenario_id and parallel_unit_count at 4096 cells. Freeze all 52 originally retained designs, but do not equate the 2048-cell counts with refined counts.
amendment.refined_inverse_scope: Evaluate one fewer than each previously refined feasible count on both 2048/4096 grids, retaining all five registered material replacements. These are targets relative to a refined candidate configuration; the prior binary minimum-count search is not a new exhaustive proof of global minimality.
amendment.prediction_inputs: Previously persisted 512-cell single-module curves only. Do not use any fine-grid observed integer count in the prediction.
amendment.interpretation: This is an explicitly documented supplemental validation design after identifying a coverage gap. All successes, errors, power-controlled cases and domain-infeasible cases are retained. It is not a preregistered discovery test or experimental validation.
